description_en: Retrieves the details of a deployment package
description_zh: 调用GetDeploymentPackage获取发布包的详情
name: GetDeploymentPackage

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace.

You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。
您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the English identifier displayed at the top of the DataStudio page for switching workspaces.

You must specify either this parameter or ProjectId to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。


该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the deployment package.

A deployment package ID is generated when you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html
parameters.help_zh:
发布包的ID。
执行https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html 和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html时，都会生成一个对应的发布包ID
parameters.name: deployment_id

Data.description_en: The details of the deployment package

DeployedItems.description_en: The details of the deployed items

items.description_en: The details of the deployed items

Status.description_en:
The status of the deployed item. Valid values:

UNPUBLISHED(0): not published
SUCCESS(1): published successfully
ERROR(2): publishing failed
CLONED(3): cloned successfully
DEPLOY_ERROR(4): publishing failed
CLONING(5): cloning in progress
REJECT(6): publishing rejected
Status.description_zh:
UNPUBLISHED(0): 未发布

SUCCESS(1): 发布成功
ERROR(2): 发布失败
CLONED(3): 克隆成功
DEPLOY_ERROR(4): 发布失败
CLONING(5): 克隆中
REJECT(6): 发布驳回

Deployment.description_en: The details of the deployment package

CheckingStatus.description_en:
The check status of the nodes involved in the deployment package. When the target environment is the development environment (toEnvironment=1), you can publish the file to the production environment only when the Status of the deployment package is 1 and CheckingStatus is empty.

7: The check failed.
8: The check is in progress
CheckingStatus.description_zh:
当前发布包涉及节点的检查状态，
当发布包的目标环境是开发环境（toEnviroment=1）时，只有发布包的Status为1并且CheckingStatus为空时，才可以继续进行文件到生产环境的发布。
7：检查未通过
8：正在处于检查中的状态

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the deployment package was generated, in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh:
发布包生成的毫秒时间
戳

CreatorId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the user who created the deployment package
CreatorId.description_zh:
发布包创建者的阿里云
用户ID

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message recorded when the deployment package fails to run (status is 2)
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
当发布包执行失败（status为2）后，
该字段记录具体的错误信息

ExecuteTime.description_en: The timestamp when the deployment package started to run, in milliseconds
ExecuteTime.description_zh:
发布包开始执行的毫秒时
间戳

FromEnvironment.description_en:
The environment from which the deployment is initiated. Valid values:

0: local
1: development environment
FromEnvironment.description_zh:
执行本次发布所在的环境
，包括0（本地）和1（开发环境）

HandlerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the user who executed the deployment package
HandlerId.description_zh:
发布包执行者的阿里云用
户ID

Name.description_en: The name of the deployment package, which is displayed on the Task Publish > Deployment Package List page
Name.description_zh:
发布包的名称，
显示在任务发布>发布包列表页面

Status.description_en:
The current status of the deployment package. Valid values:

0: ready
1: successful
2: failed
Status.description_zh:
发布包当前的状态
，包括0（就绪）、1（成功）和2（失败）

ToEnvironment.description_en:
The target environment to which the file information is published. Valid values:

1: development environment
2: production environment
ToEnvironment.description_zh:
发布文件信息的目标环境，
包括1（开发环境）和2（生产环境）

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
